mapper.select: SELECT r.role_code FROM sys_role r JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND ur.family_id = #{familyId} AND r.status = 'ENABLED' LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT a.auth_code FROM sys_auth a JOIN sys_role_auth ra ON ra.auth_id = a.id JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ra.role_id AND r.status = 'ENABLED' JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND ur.family_id = #{familyId}
SELECT ur.family_id AS familyId, r.role_code AS roleCode FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON ur.role_id = r.id AND r.status = 'ENABLED' WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND ur.family_id IS NOT NULL

SELECT DISTINCT u.email FROM sys_user u JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.id JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE r.role_code = 'OPS' AND ur.family_id IS NULL AND u.deleted = 0 AND u.email IS NOT NULL AND u.email <> ''
